import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import sparse
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.multioutput import MultiOutputClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
import xgboost as xgb

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Define targets and IDs
targets = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]
test_ids = test["id"].values

# Split training data to ensure hold-out validation
train_subset, val_subset = train_test_split(train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)

# Preprocess text with word-level TF-IDF
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=50000, ngram_range=(1, 2), strip_accents="unicode", lowercase=True
)
X_train_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_subset["comment_text"])
X_val_word = word_vectorizer.transform(val_subset["comment_text"])
X_test_word = word_vectorizer.transform(test["comment_text"])

# Add character-level TF-IDF to capture patterns like abbreviations and profanity
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb",
    ngram_range=(3, 5),
    max_features=20000,
    min_df=1,
    max_df=0.95,
)
X_train_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_subset["comment_text"])
X_val_char = char_vectorizer.transform(val_subset["comment_text"])
X_test_char = char_vectorizer.transform(test["comment_text"])

# Concatenate word and character features using sparse hstack (memory efficient)
X_train = sparse.hstack([X_train_word, X_train_char])
X_val = sparse.hstack([X_val_word, X_val_char])
X_test = sparse.hstack([X_test_word, X_test_char])

y_train = train_subset[targets].values
y_val = val_subset[targets].values

# Train XGBoost Model
xgb_model = MultiOutputClassifier(
    xgb.XGBClassifier(
        objective="binary:logistic",
        n_estimators=200,
        learning_rate=0.1,
        random_state=42,
        tree_method="hist",
        max_depth=6,
        use_label_encoder=False,
    ),
    n_jobs=-1,
)
xgb_model.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Train Logistic Regression Model (Augmentation)
# Using 'saga' solver for sparse input support
lr_model = MultiOutputClassifier(
    LogisticRegression(
        penalty="l2", solver="saga", max_iter=500, tol=1e-3, random_state=42
    ),
    n_jobs=-1,
)
lr_model.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Generate Predictions
xgb_pred_list = xgb_model.predict_proba(X_test)
lr_pred_list = lr_model.predict_proba(X_test)
# Weighted average ensemble (0.6 XGB, 0.4 LR)
preds_list = np.array(xgb_pred_list)
lr_preds_list = np.array(lr_pred_list)
preds_ens_list = 0.6 * preds_list + 0.4 * lr_preds_list

# Convert list of arrays to single array (n_samples, n_classes)
preds_2d = np.column_stack([pred[:, 1] for pred in preds_ens_list])

# Validate on Hold-out Set
xgb_val_list = xgb_model.predict_proba(X_val)
lr_val_list = lr_model.predict_proba(X_val)
val_preds_ens_list = 0.6 * np.array(xgb_val_list) + 0.4 * np.array(lr_val_list)
val_preds_2d = np.column_stack([arr[:, 1] for arr in val_preds_ens_list])

auc_scores = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds_2d, average=None)
mean_auc = np.mean(auc_scores)
print(f"Validation Mean Column-wise ROC AUC: {mean_auc:.5f}")

# Save Submission - PRESERVED FROM PREVIOUS SOLUTION
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_ids,
        "toxic": preds_2d[:, 0],
        "severe_toxic": preds_2d[:, 1],
        "obscene": preds_2d[:, 2],
        "threat": preds_2d[:, 3],
        "insult": preds_2d[:, 4],
        "identity_hate": preds_2d[:, 5],
    }
)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows")
